lineage.contractShapeFixtureReads: commit-addressed git objects only; shape and vocabulary, never a governance resolution

r17.meaning: one Generation-1 cohort resolution against the frozen Generation-1 draw, one Generation-1 reserve namespace and one Generation-1 replacement ledger
r17.reuse: the new contract validates the Generation-1 prefix by CALLING R17's own resolver over the Generation-1 draw and ledger with no facts; R17 is imported, never edited, broadened or wrapped into accepting Generation 2

contract.inputs: already-normalised committed-governance facts; producing them from committed A2 bytes is a later, separately authorised adapter's job

examples.carriedGeneration1Success: resolution Gen2 / occupant Gen1 / acquisition Gen1
examples.generation2ReserveAcquisition: resolution Gen2 / occupant Gen2 / acquisition Gen2
examples.primaryFirstAcquiredInGeneration2: resolution Gen2 / occupant Gen1 / acquisition Gen2

generationModel.factGenerationIsProvenance: checked against an explicit closed registry of the adjudication records each generation committed; a relabelled fact is found in the other generation's registry and refused

GENERATION2_RESERVE_SCHEDULE.identityDigest: scheduleEntrySha256 = sha256(canonicalStringify(schedule entry without scheduleEntrySha256)), plus frameEntrySha256

occupantModel.reserveIdentity: namespace + namespace-local position + that namespace's own digest + organisation; Generation-1 reserve N is never Generation-2 reserve N

chainModel.shape: original primary -> Generation-1 reserve transitions -> Generation-1 terminal occupant -> Generation-2 reserve transitions

generation2Rooting.firstGeneration2Entry: replaces exactly the slot's GENERATION1_TERMINAL_OCCUPANT, previousSequenceForSlot null
generation2Rooting.laterGeneration2Entry: replaces exactly the slot's previous GENERATION2_RESERVE_REPLACEMENT, previousSequenceForSlot = that Generation-2 sequence

acquisitionOfRecord.recoveryRequires: selectionBasis EXPLICIT_ADJUDICATION_SELECTION by the fact's own adjudication, with the original result and run retained

carryForward.requiredFor: a Generation-1 success that is the current acquisition of record in a Generation-2 resolution
binds: no Generation-2 transition in the slot

requires: current occupant derived from selection + Generation-1 chain + Generation-2 chain
exactly one terminal acquisition-of-record fact for that exact occupant
adjudication, acquisition-of-record result, run reference and actual policy bound
a Generation-1 fact only through a genuine carry-forward admission in an untouched slot
a Generation-2 reserve only through a genuine Generation-2 fact naming its schedule identity
readyRule.privateBranding: WeakSet-minted; spread, structuredClone, JSON round trip, literal and R17 READY all rejected; no unsafe or test-only mint

continuity.ownerRule: resolution context is not acquisition authority: resolutionGenerationId alone is never an evidence change; a carried authority's acquisitionGenerationId stays Generation 1 and is compared with R17's generationId

r17OccupantMapping.PRIMARY: PRIMARY with the same draw entry
r17OccupantMapping.RESERVE_REPLACEMENT: GENERATION1_RESERVE_REPLACEMENT in GENERATION1_DRAW_RESERVE with the same position and draw-entry digest

identityDisclosure: contract and type names, namespace sizes, commit identifiers and two file digests only; no organisation, eche row key, selection index, reserve position, run reference, host, URL, document or sealed filename
nextOwnerQuestion: Should a new governance-only R38B task be authorised to adapt the exact terminal Generation-2 committed A2 history into this new cross-generation contract, attempt Governance V5, and then derive the real V4 -> V5 DEV_TRAIN continuity?
immutability: append-only. This record is never edited; a correction is a new record
